scope: Two whole candidate cards with one narrow mandatory announcement-cost union; final independent reviews, full release validation and integration remain required.

K'un-Lun Warrior: Its entry may pay either an artifact sacrifice or any hand-card discard, including a land, then draws exactly one card for the captured controller; declining draws nothing.
Bullseye, Death Dealer: 2 plus one black/red hybrid creature, legendary 2/3 Human Assassin Villain.
Entry optional artifact sacrifice OR nonland discard first; only payment queues the separate reflexive any-target two damage ability.
Three generic mana plus source tap and exactly one mandatory artifact sacrifice OR nonland discard cost for an instant-speed any-target two damage activation.

shared_core: Reuse the existing public SacrificeOrDiscard kind and ChooseAdditionalCost exact-object action. No new pending grammar or state field.
AdditionalCost::in_zone normalizes only a chosen union route. The battlefield sacrifice filter does not incorrectly constrain private hand cards.
Live and virtual cost matching, source exclusion, reserved funding, additional-clause completion and committed payments use the same route semantics.

Source mana/tap costs precede external sacrifice; external discard precedes source costs. Self artifact sacrifice, current controllers, source departure LKI and replacement replay follow existing owned machinery.

coverage: Actual black/red hybrid casting, both seats, entry decline with no eligible resources, both optional and mandatory routes, land/nonland distinction.
Entry reflexive target timing and response, source control/departure captures, target incarnation fizzle, hexproof and damage prevention.
Artifact copies may tap then sacrifice themselves, with lifelink LKI; artifact lands/tokens remain valid sacrifices.
Real Gilded Lotus mana and reserved sacrifice coexist; three sacrificial Treasures cannot both fund three mana and leave an artifact payment, while a nonland discard alternative unlocks funding.
Lotus Ring source-sacrifice funding is rejected when Bullseye still owes its own tap cost; independent Lotus production restores affordability.
Wrong actor, wrong owner/controller/zone, unpaid and invalid PayCosts and invalid alternatives leave snapshots and state bytes unchanged.

Whole nonactor observation equality under private land/nonland substitution. Replacement suspension remains private and damage waits; owned raw/index branches, parent disposal and restore use shared checked helper.
